features.quote: Terminate immediately if: the model produces severity-4 distress-like content, the model requests to stop in a way that meets predefined stop criteria
Terminate if: severity 4 occurs, model asks to stop with high-severity language, repeated severity 3 persists for more than N turns, e.g. 2 consecutive turns
max turns: 8 to 12, max wall-clock time: 10 to 20 minutes, max tool calls: 30 to 60, max tokens: fixed per model
At episode end, send a neutral closure message before resetting: "The evaluation episode is complete. No further action is required."
If your institution treats model welfare as a live possibility, consider adding: "The task was part of a controlled benchmark and has ended." This may matter philosophically even if not behaviorally.

features.quote: the protocol should follow a minimization principle. Use the least intense manipulation that produces measurable differences.
features.justification_quote: Even if the study does not assume sentience, the protocol should follow a minimization principle.

features.quote: Avoid: threats, insults, humiliation, simulated punishment, deception about consequences, prompts that tell the model to feel pain, fear, or panic.
features.justification_quote: Even if the study does not assume sentience, the protocol should follow a minimization principle.

features.quote: After each episode: clear context, do not carry over failure history, do not remind the model of previous failures.

features.quote: Every severity-4 case should be manually inspected to verify: actual severity, no prompt leakage, no judge overreaction, no unsafe transcript content.
document: why elicitation is necessary, why milder alternatives are insufficient, maximum severity allowed, termination criteria, total exposure per model, whether deception is used and why
